visual.general_description: Three lettered rows (A, B, C), each pairing a line drawing of a heart with one or two grayscale chest radiographs showing pacemaker leads.
visual.detailed_description: A tall composite with three horizontal bands labelled A, B and C at the top left. Each band has a black-and-white schematic heart on the left with stippled ventricular walls. Bands A and B have one chest radiograph on the right; band C has two chest radiographs. The radiographs show radio-dense pacing leads and electrodes with red or black printed text labels (for example atrial lead, ventricular lead, atrial and ventricular bipoles, common atrial and ventricular leads, a pigtail catheter). Sternal wires are visible in panel A. No patient names, dates or scanner text are visible.

panels.general_description: Panel A pairs a line drawing of a heart with a grayscale chest radiograph showing pacing leads and sternal wires.
panels.detailed_description: Panel A has a black-and-white line drawing of a heart and great vessels on the left, with stippled shading of the ventricular wall and a short dark vertical mark near the outflow region. On the right is a grayscale radiograph of the chest in which three sternal wire loops lie along the midline and several thin radio-dense leads run through the cardiac region; one thick lead with a long bright coil segment ends near the lower right, and a second thinner lead curves down from the upper right. Three red text labels are printed over the radiograph; all three are blurred and illegible at this resolution. A scale-like ruler edge is visible along the bottom of the radiograph and a round object is partly visible at the upper right corner. The letter "A" is printed at the top left of the panel. No names, dates or other text are visible.
